trends.name: AI-powered credential theft embedded in developer tools and IDE plugins
trends.rationale: Anthropic's Claude Code Desktop preview pane contained a zero-click flaw enabling silent credential theft of SSH keys, AWS credentials, and Claude OAuth tokens without user interaction (Oct 14). This represents a new attack surface where AI development tools themselves become credential harvesting vectors.

articles.title: Anthropic 'SneakPeek' Flaw Is a Silent Zero-Click Threat

trends.name: GhostAction credential-theft campaign targeting GitHub repositories at scale
trends.rationale: GhostAction compromised approximately 1,900 GitHub accounts to target over 30,000 repositories across 3,000 users and organizations, with a spike observed on October 8-9, 2026 (Oct 15). This represents a sustained, large-scale campaign leveraging GitHub as a primary attack vector for open-source ecosystems.

articles.title: GhostAction Compromises About 1,900 GitHub Accounts, Targets Over 30,000 Repositories

trends.name: Thermal imaging integration with UL-listed life safety solutions becoming standard
trends.rationale: Everon and Teledyne FLIR jointly released the first UL 2684-listed thermal imaging solution that is NFPA 72-compliant (Oct 14). This represents a significant product milestone in thermal technology standardization for life safety integration.

articles.title: Everon Joins Teledyne FLIR to Offer UL-Listed Thermal Image Solution

trends.name: Security integrator market confidence reaching sustained high levels
trends.rationale: Security Market Index reports confidence at 83% in September/October 2026, marking the third consecutive survey period where at least 80% of participants gauged conditions as excellent or good (Oct 14). This sustained confidence level suggests positive market momentum and integrator sentiment.

articles.title: Security Market Index: Confidence Up to 83% in September/October

trends.name: Consolidation and M&A activity in security integration and fire/life safety
trends.rationale: RapidFire acquired Access Systems to enhance fire, life safety and security solutions (Oct 13). D-Tools opened registration for its 2027 User Conference following the Portal.io merger (Oct 14). These transactions reflect ongoing industry consolidation among integrators and software platforms.

trends.name: Video evidence integrity and authentication gaining industry focus
trends.rationale: SWEAR launched the Community Video Integrity Project designed to add an independent, complementary layer of video authentication and chain-of-custody verification (Oct 1). This demonstrates emerging industry recognition that video evidence authentication is becoming a critical operational requirement for physical security deployments.

articles.title: SWEAR Launches Video Evidence Integrity Protection Program

trends.name: npm and open-source package management security tightening in response to supply chain attacks
trends.rationale: GitHub tightened npm publishing by expiring unvalidated trusted publishing configurations 48 hours after creation following researcher findings that attackers could push new versions of different users' packages without credential theft (Oct 13). This represents a platform-level response to demonstrated supply chain vulnerability, distinct from but complementary to individual compromise incidents.

articles.title: GitHub Tightens npm Publishing After Flaw Left 1,500+ Packages Vulnerable to Hijacking

trends.name: Security workflow design prioritizing operator context and real-world usability
trends.rationale: Security Sales reports that integrators designing systems with better operator context close the gap between test scenarios and real-life situations, resulting in systems customers actually use (Oct 13). This suggests a shift toward human-centered security design where operational context and usability are primary design factors.

articles.title: Designing Security Workflows That Give Operators Better Context

trends.name: AI-powered security camera capabilities being retrofitted to existing physical camera infrastructure
trends.rationale: Security Sales reports that the next wave of security AI will be layered onto existing camera systems already deployed at customer sites, fundamentally changing the business model for integrators (Oct 2). This signals a shift from hardware-centric upgrades to software-centric AI analytics added to legacy infrastructure.

articles.title: How to Add Security AI to the Camera Already on the Wall

trends.rationale: Multiple signals show accelerating market consolidation and standardization. ESA launched its Industry Performance Index to help integrators benchmark performance (Sept 28), GSX 2026 achieved record attendance of 16,000+ registrants from 100 countries with 17% growth over 2025 (Sept 28). trends.name: Agentic threat actors conducting destructive cloud infrastructure attacks
trends.rationale: JadePuffer, characterized as an AI-powered threat actor, compromised an Azure tenant and conducted destructive attacks deleting cloud-based storage, applications, and databases, reportedly using exposed credentials (Sept 28). This represents the emergence of autonomous adversaries leveraging AI capabilities to conduct large-scale destructive attacks against cloud infrastructure, distinct from traditional credential theft.

articles.title: JadePuffer AI Actor Compromises Azure Tenant in Destructive Cloud Attack

trends.name: China-aligned threat actors targeting US AI policy expertise and decision-makers
trends.rationale: China-nexus cyber espionage group TA419 executed multiple credential phishing campaigns targeting AI experts at U.S. think tanks, universities, and legal sector organizations (Oct 4). This represents strategic targeting of American AI policy influencers and technical expertise holders by state-aligned actors using AitM phishing techniques, indicating AI policy infrastructure has become a high-priority espionage target.

articles.title: China-Aligned TA419 Targets U.S. AI Policy Experts With Microsoft AitM Phishing

trends.name: Credential harvesting from internet-facing appliances remains active threat
trends.rationale: FBI and Secret Service warned that the FortiBleed credential harvesting campaign targeting internet-facing Fortinet FortiGate firewalls and SSL VPN gateways remains active and has amassed 86,644 device credentials (Oct 7). This demonstrates that large-scale, persistent credential harvesting against perimeter security appliances continues to be a viable attack vector despite public awareness.

articles.title: FBI Warns FortiBleed Remains Active After Amassing 86,644 Fortinet Device Credentials

trends.name: Malware abusing privileged drivers to disable security monitoring
trends.rationale: Lunex Stealer malware distributed via compromised Ukrainian websites abuses AMD drivers to disable security monitoring and steal browser credentials as part of a wider malware-as-a-service platform (Sept 26). This demonstrates sophisticated attack chains that use legitimate driver vulnerabilities to bypass endpoint security controls and enable credential theft at scale.

articles.title: Lunex Stealer Abuses AMD Driver to Disable Security Monitoring and Steal Browser Credentials

trends.name: Sophisticated phishing kits adding session management and traffic control capabilities
trends.rationale: Security researchers identified Wazza, a phishing kit that goes beyond copying login pages to include filtering, session management, and traffic controls in the infrastructure delivering phishing pages (Oct 8). This represents an evolution in phishing infrastructure sophistication, where attackers are building enterprise-grade capabilities into their attack delivery mechanisms.

articles.title: Wazza Phishkit Targets Banking, Government, and Manufacturing Across the US, EU, and Australia

trends.name: AI-powered visual analytics platforms consolidating multiple security functions
trends.rationale: Securitas Technology and IQSIGHT won a best electronic security project award for a platform combining visual analytics, alarm management, and live communication (Sept 24). Securitas Technology also released a 2027 Global Technology Outlook Report highlighting how AI, cloud platforms and connected security ecosystems are reshaping security (Oct 5).

trends.name: Malware exploiting legitimate security tools and driver infrastructure to evade detection
trends.rationale: Two separate malware campaigns across 14 days demonstrate attackers weaponizing legitimate software and kernel-level infrastructure meant to protect systems. CLOSEDQUORUM malware uses AI model voting to dynamically select theft targets while evading traditional detection (Sept 23). Both incidents show attackers bypassing security infrastructure at the driver level rather than defeating detection through obfuscation alone.

trends.rationale: Two major sector-specific access control modernization initiatives were announced within days. Keenfinity Group created MiCOS as a focused access control solutions business (Sept 18), signaling renewed market demand for specialized access control.
